use_case: Developers use GitHub Copilot to write and fix code while GitHub Actions automates CI/CD pipelines to build, test, and deploy that code on every commit.
Teams launch instant cloud-based dev environments via Codespaces and trigger automated build and test workflows through GitHub Actions to validate changes before merge.
Teams track bugs and feature requests in GitHub Issues and organize them into roadmaps and sprint boards in GitHub Projects to maintain visibility across the development lifecycle.
GitHub Advanced Security scans code for vulnerabilities on every pull request triggered by GitHub Actions, enabling automated security enforcement before code is merged.
Copilot performs an initial automated code review on pull requests, surfacing suggestions and flagging issues before human reviewers step in to finalize approval.
